items.text: Has the procurement authority adopted Quality and Cost-Based Selection (QCBS) rather than lowest-cost (L1) bidding?
items.statuteRef: GFR 2017 Rule 192 & Manual for Procurement of Goods (2022)
items.guidance: Clinical AI must not be procured under commodity L1 rules; technical quality benchmark must carry at least 70% to 80% weight.

items.text: Is pre-award sandboxed computational bench testing on local clinical samples mandated before financial bid opening?
items.statuteRef: GeM Special Bidding Guidelines for Software & AI Services
items.guidance: Prevents award to algorithms that fail on local demographic data.

items.text: Are proprietary single-vendor hardware lock-in clauses explicitly excluded from tender requirements?
items.statuteRef: GFR 2017 Rule 144(i) (Ensuring competitive non-restrictive technical specs)
items.guidance: Software must operate on multi-vendor standard imaging / diagnostic hardware.

items.text: Does the vendor provide external clinical validation on Indian populations demonstrating Sensitivity ≥90% and Specificity ≥85%?
items.statuteRef: ICMR Guidelines for AI in Healthcare & WHO Guidance on Health AI
items.guidance: Self-reported training accuracy or synthetic benchmark testing is insufficient.

items.text: Are validation metrics disaggregated across gender, age brackets, and prevalent national comorbidities?
items.statuteRef: TRIPOD-AI Reporting Guidelines
items.guidance: Ensures algorithmic equity across vulnerable subgroups.

items.text: Is the reference clinical gold standard clearly documented and verified by a multi-expert arbitration panel?
items.statuteRef: CDSCO Medical Device Clinical Investigation Guidance
items.guidance: Double-blind expert reads with tie-breaker arbitration.

items.text: Does the system explicitly operate in an assistive 'Human-in-the-Loop' decision-support capacity without replacing doctor authorization?
items.statuteRef: Clinical Establishments Act & National Medical Commission Ethics Regulations
items.guidance: Clinicians must hold ultimate diagnostic, prescribing, and treatment authority.

items.text: Is there an automated deterministic fallback mechanism when cellular network connectivity fails?
items.statuteRef: National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC) Hardware Norms
items.guidance: Crucial for remote PHCs, Sub-Centres, and mobile health vans.

items.text: Has the solution been audited for algorithmic bias against marginalized, tribal, and rural patient cohorts?
items.statuteRef: NITI Aayog Strategy for AI in Healthcare for India (SAHI)
items.guidance: Prevent disparate false-negative rates in vulnerable populations.

items.text: Are all patient data, model inference inputs, and server logs hosted strictly on MeitY-empanelled CSP data centres in India?
items.statuteRef: Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023 & CERT-In Directives
items.guidance: Cross-border transfer of sensitive public health records without authorization is illegal.

items.text: Does the routine procurement and inference workflow function with zero unencrypted Protected Health Information (PHI)?
items.statuteRef: ABDM Health Data Management Policy (HDMP)
items.guidance: Anonymization or pseudonymization before cloud ingestion.

items.text: Is the vendor contractually prohibited from using state citizen health data to train or fine-tune proprietary commercial models?
items.statuteRef: Department of Expenditure Public Procurement Integrity Guidelines
items.guidance: State retains sovereign data ownership.

items.text: Does the software hold official Sandbox Certification for ABDM Milestones (M1, M2, and M3)?
items.statuteRef: National Health Authority (NHA) ABDM Integration Guidelines
items.guidance: Allows ABHA linkage and state registry synchronization.

items.text: Does the system support open standards: HL7 FHIR R4 for health records and native DICOM 3.0 for medical imaging?
items.statuteRef: National Digital Health Blueprint (NDHB) Standards
items.guidance: Prevents proprietary lock-in with state PACS and EMR systems.

items.text: Are diagnostic classifications mapped to standard clinical terminologies (SNOMED-CT, LOINC, ICD-11)?
items.statuteRef: MoHFW Electronic Health Record (EHR) Standards for India
items.guidance: Ensures longitudinal epidemiological tracking across state health databases.

items.text: Has the vendor submitted a standardized Model Card / Factsheet detailing training demographics and known edge failure cases?
items.statuteRef: ISO/IEC 42001 & NITI Aayog Responsible AI Framework
items.guidance: Ensures algorithmic accountability and transparency.

items.text: Does the clinical interface provide visual explainability (e.g. Grad-CAM heatmaps, bounding boxes) for radiological/morphological alerts?
items.statuteRef: WHO Regulatory Guidance on AI for Health
items.guidance: Allows medical officers to rapidly verify anatomical basis of suspicion.

items.text: Is there a tamper-evident audit log recording every inference timestamp, model version, and user action?
items.statuteRef: CERT-In Cyber Security Audit Guidelines & Indian Evidence Act
items.guidance: Crucial for medical-legal auditability.

items.text: Does the vendor possess a valid CDSCO manufacturing (MD-5/MD-9) or import (MD-15) license for Software as a Medical Device (SaMD)?
items.statuteRef: CDSCO Medical Device Rules (MDR 2017) under Drugs & Cosmetics Act
items.guidance: Statutory prerequisite for clinical deployment in public facilities.

items.text: Has the validation study or pilot design been reviewed and approved by an ICMR-registered Institutional Ethics Committee (IEC)?
items.statuteRef: ICMR National Ethical Guidelines for Biomedical and Health Research
items.guidance: Mandatory for clinical research or pilot trials.

items.text: Has the bidder submitted an affidavit declaring no conflict of interest or undisclosed exclusivity pacts with hardware manufacturers?
items.statuteRef: GFR 2017 Rule 175 (Code of Integrity for Public Procurement)
items.guidance: Ensures anti-corruption and competitive fairness.

items.text: Does the contract include a mandatory semi-annual algorithmic drift audit and recalibration clause at no extra licensing fee?
items.statuteRef: GeM Service Level Agreement Norms & ISO/IEC 23894
items.guidance: Guarantees sustained accuracy over the full multi-year contract lifecycle.

items.text: Has the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) including compute infrastructure, maintenance, and staff training been fully costed?
items.statuteRef: Department of Expenditure Guidelines on TCO Evaluation
items.guidance: Prevents unanticipated runaway cloud and support costs.

items.text: Is there a structured exit management and data handover protocol (transfer within 30 days in open formats)?
items.statuteRef: GFR 2017 Rule 225 (Contract Management & Transition)
items.guidance: Eliminates state health department vendor lock-in upon contract conclusion.
